notes: 2-D circular footprint; walls retain door and window cuts, with windows blocked below the sill.
An optional model shell keeps the full circular footprint over the modeled floor.
Visible mesh bounds are checked in the current world transform; unchanged mesh matrices reuse cached hulls.
Main floor furniture and columns are included; upper cabinetry and small decorations are excluded by type or vertical clearance.

model.note: Current-state geometry inventory. Bounds include hidden assembly parts; use articulated visible-mesh tests for swept solids. This is not a material photorealism score or physical-use acceptance.

roomRadiance.note: Room-positioned PMREM reflections only. This is not a lightmap or diffuse global illumination bake.

diffuseBounce.nearWallNote: 0.7 m WebGPU falloff keeps inset probes contributing near walls; adjacent-room leakage can occur within that range because wall occlusion is not evaluated by runtime sampling.
diffuseBounce.crossBackendAtlasLoad: supported by shared packed atlas layout; preserved source texel type

mirror.note: Two reflectors are attached to the final moving bath mirror leaves with recursive bounces disabled. Live output remains unverified until rendered on the selected backend. Three.js updates them only when visible mirror faces are rendered.

storage.method: 按模型内空尺寸扣除18mm板厚、分隔、层板与门板；未扣实际五金/管线/通风净空，非施工或承重认证
